notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
